description: Proposed value and responsibility exchanges; payer settlements are distinct from platform fees.

relations.name: Authorize controlled billing
relations.description: Finance defines acceptance criteria; billing executes approved runs.

relations.name: Agree collection tradeoffs
relations.description: Finance and collections agree cash, cost and payer-treatment guardrails.

relations.name: Explain an obligation
relations.description: Creditor supplies a recognizable bill and correction route.

relations.name: Settle a legitimate bill
relations.description: Payment reaches the creditor's contracted bank route; POM custody is not assumed.

relations.name: Offer supported resolution
relations.description: Collections provides proportionate options and honors active holds.

relations.name: Coordinate rent support
relations.description: Housing separates current rent from arrears and supports sustained resolution.

relations.name: Authorize representation
relations.description: The payer defines and may revoke a bounded case mandate.

relations.name: Request accepted support
relations.description: An authorized minimal referral retains a sender owner until accepted.

relations.name: Agree the next step
relations.description: Adviser submits a proposal; creditor staff owns the decision.

relations.name: Commission integration
relations.description: Creditor funds an agreed implementation and acceptance scope; terms are proposed.

relations.name: Hand over a tested service
relations.description: Implementation supplies mappings, failure behavior and recovery evidence.

relations.name: Expose unsafe processing state
relations.description: Operations identifies stale feeds and uncertain receipts for action suppression.
